description: Fetch full biographical profile for a single judge: positions on record — judicial appointments across all courts plus non-judicial roles — education, political affiliations, and ABA ratings. The position list is paginated upstream and walked under a page bound; the response reports whether it was truncated. Obtain person IDs from courtlistener_search_judges results.

person_id.description: Judge person ID from a search result's person_id field. Identifies a specific judge across all courts they have served on.

name: courtlistener_get_judge

aba_ratings.description: ABA qualification ratings, expanded to readable labels (e.g., "Well Qualified").

dob.description: Date of birth as CourtListener stores it, always full ISO 8601 — but the month and day are placeholders unless dob_granularity is "day". Read dob_granularity before presenting this as an exact date. Null if not recorded.

dob_city.description: City of birth; null if not recorded.

dob_granularity.description: Precision actually recorded for dob: "year", "month", or "day". Null when CourtListener recorded no precision. An unrecognized upstream value passes through unchanged.

dob_state.description: State of birth; null if not recorded.

dod.description: Date of death as CourtListener stores it, always full ISO 8601 — precision qualified by dod_granularity, as with dob. Null if living or not recorded.

dod_granularity.description: Precision actually recorded for dod: "year", "month", or "day". Null when CourtListener recorded no precision.

degree.description: Raw CourtListener degree-level code (e.g. "ba"); null if not recorded.

degree_label.description: Degree level expanded to a readable label (e.g. "Juris Doctor (J.D.)"). An unmapped code passes through as the code itself; null if not recorded.

year.description: Graduation year; null if not recorded.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: Person ID does not exist in CourtListener. `rate_limited`: 429 from CourtListener, or no request slot opened within the wait budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

fjc_id.description: Federal Judicial Center ID for cross-referencing with FJC data; null if not available.

notice.description: Present only when positions[] was truncated: what was withheld.

affiliation.description: Political party, expanded to a readable label (e.g., "Democratic").

date_end.description: End date of this affiliation; null if current.

positions.description: Positions on record, across all courts — judicial appointments plus non-judicial roles (private practice, prosecutor, professor), which carry no court and describe themselves in job_title. CourtListener paginates this list and the walk is bounded, so read the truncated flag before treating it as a complete career.

appointer.description: Position URI of the appointing authority (e.g., ".../positions/123/"), not resolved to a name; null if elected or not recorded.

court_id.description: Court identifier — use to filter opinions by this judge.

date_confirmation.description: Date confirmed; null if not recorded.

date_nominated.description: Date nominated; null if not recorded.

date_start.description: Date the position started as CourtListener stores it, always full ISO 8601 — the month and day are placeholders unless date_start_granularity is "day". Null if not recorded.

date_start_granularity.description: Precision actually recorded for date_start: "year", "month", or "day". Null when CourtListener recorded no precision.

date_termination.description: Date the position ended as CourtListener stores it, always full ISO 8601 — precision qualified by date_termination_granularity. Null if current.

date_termination_granularity.description: Precision actually recorded for date_termination: "year", "month", or "day". Null when CourtListener recorded no precision.

job_title.description: Free-text title for a role with no position_type code (e.g. "Assistant district attorney"); empty on judicial rows.

nomination_process.description: Selection method, expanded to a readable label (e.g., "Appointment (President)"); null if not recorded.

organization_name.description: Employer for a non-judicial role; empty on judicial rows, which use court.

position_type.description: Raw CourtListener position-type code (e.g. "jud", "c-jud") — the value the /positions/ position_type filter takes. Empty for non-judicial roles, which describe themselves in job_title.

position_type_label.description: Position type expanded to a readable label (e.g. "Judge", "Chief Judge"). An unmapped code passes through as the code itself; empty for non-judicial roles.

termination_reason.description: Raw CourtListener termination-reason code (e.g. "other_pos"); null if still serving.

termination_reason_label.description: Termination reason expanded to a readable label (e.g. "Appointed to Other Judgeship"). An unmapped code passes through as the code itself; null if still serving.

truncated.description: True when the bounded /positions/ page walk stopped with pages outstanding — positions[] is then a prefix of the person's record, not the whole of it. False when the walk reached the end.

title: Get Judge Profile
